title: Volester - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Volester in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A flying early Nevron with a clean Ice weakness.

sections.title: How to Beat the Volester
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Ice is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.
